system.description:
Spend 3 Hope to run a straight path
through the battlefield to a point within
Far range, making an attack against all
adversaries within your weapon's range
along that path.
Choose the order in which you deal
damage to the targets you succeeded
against.
For the first, roll your weapon damage
with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.
Then remove adie from your damage
roll and deal the remaining damage to
the next target.
Continue to remove a die for each
subsequent target until you have no
more damage dice or adversaries.
You can’t target the same adversary
more than once per attack.
